outbox_event_email_payload.name: outbox_event_email_payload
outbox_event_email_payload.value:
(
        ("outbox_event"."email_template" IS NULL AND "outbox_event"."email_locale" IS NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_recipient" IS NULL AND "outbox_event"."email_first_name" IS NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_title" IS NULL AND "outbox_event"."email_deadline" IS NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_link" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("outbox_event"."email_template" IS NOT NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_template" IN ('invitation', 'reminder', 'approval', 'escalation')
          AND "outbox_event"."email_locale" IS NOT NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_locale" IN ('de', 'en')
          AND "outbox_event"."email_recipient" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(trim("outbox_event"."email_recipient")) > 0
          AND "outbox_event"."email_title" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(trim("outbox_event"."email_title")) > 0
          AND "outbox_event"."email_link" IS NOT NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_link" LIKE '/%'
          AND "outbox_event"."email_link" NOT LIKE '//%'
          AND position('?' in "outbox_event"."email_link") = 0
          AND position('#' in "outbox_event"."email_link") = 0
          AND position(chr(92) in "outbox_event"."email_link") = 0)
      )

segment_decision_target.name: segment_decision_target
segment_decision_target.value:
("segment_decision"."scope" = 'total' and "segment_decision"."business_unit_id" is null) or
        ("segment_decision"."scope" = 'bu_mg' and "segment_decision"."business_unit_id" is not null)

segment_decision_levels.name: segment_decision_levels
segment_decision_levels.value:
"segment_decision"."ist_impact_level" between 1 and 3 and "segment_decision"."ist_quality_level" between 1 and 3
        and "segment_decision"."soll_impact_level" between 1 and 3 and "segment_decision"."soll_quality_level" between 1 and 3

segmentation_round_model_version.name: segmentation_round_model_version
segmentation_round_model_version.value:
("segmentation_round"."status" = 'draft' and "segmentation_round"."model_version" is null) or
        ("segmentation_round"."status" in ('open', 'closed') and "segmentation_round"."model_version" > 0)

segment_model_activation.name: segment_model_activation
segment_model_activation.value:
("segment_model"."status" = 'draft' and "segment_model"."activated_at" is null) or
        ("segment_model"."status" in ('active', 'retired') and "segment_model"."activated_at" is not null)
